title: Every object embeds in one whose locally constant integer cochain complex is exact
statement: Let G,A,E,C,e be as in [def-exc-discrete-modules-category] and [def-sp-abelian], with G compact Hausdorff totally disconnected. Assume C(M)^n ≃ LC(G^n,E(M)) additively and that coefficient maps and differentials obey the two coordinate formulas of lem-sc-locally-constant-cochains-exact. For every M of A there exist an object N of A and a monomorphism f: M → N such that C(N) is exact at every n>0. This asserts an acyclic embedding for the complex, without specifying a delta-functor or any degree-zero identification.

proof.text: Construct integerCoinduced G E(M) as the actual locally constant function group with right translation. The proved open-normal right-invariance theorem supplies an open subgroup contained in the stabilizer of every function; Subgroup.isOpen_of_openSubgroup then makes the whole stabilizer open. Construct the orbit function x ↦ rho(x)m: the preimage of the open stabilizer of m under y ↦ x⁻¹y proves local constancy. The resulting integerOrbitMap is linear and equivariant. Evaluation at 1 shows cancellation of morphisms, proving it monic. Set N = E.inverse.obj D and f = E.unitIso.hom followed by E.inverse.map of the orbit map. Functorial preservation of monomorphisms proves Mono f.

Prove the evaluation contraction privately in this module for every additive coefficient group V and any additive differential satisfying the displayed formula. Define h_n(F)(g)(x) = F(cons x g)(1) directly. Continuous insertion proves local constancy in x. For local constancy as a whole function of x, the open equality locus in G^n times G and isCompact_univ.eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually give one neighborhood of g working for all x. Prove additivity pointwise. Prove the two Fin.contractNth insertion identities by Fin.cases. Expand d h + h d pointwise, split the second sum with Fin.sum_univ_succ, and rewrite pow_succ and zsmul. Each inserted merge and deletion term has the opposite sign; abel finishes the identity. This also proves the degree-one case n=0.

Use the counit isomorphism E(E.inverse D) ≅ D to give an additive coefficient equivalence q. Postcompose locally constant cochains with q and compose with e to obtain coordinate equivalences t in every degree. Conjugate the differential by t. The assumed hd, additivity of q, and Rep.hom_comm_apply for the counit show exactly the right-translation differential formula needed by the proved contraction. For n=k+1 and a cocycle x, apply the contraction identity to t(x); the transported outgoing differential is zero. Therefore x is the incoming differential of t_k.symm(h_k(t(x))). HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' and ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff give ExactAt (k+1). No coefficient-map naturality assumption is needed for this objectwise construction.

lean.statement:
theorem locallyConstantCochains_acyclic_embedding
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (A : Type v) [Category.{w} A] [Abelian A]
    (E : A ≌ DiscreteContinuousRep.{0, u, max u s} ℤ G)
    (C : A ⥤ CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{max u s} ℕ)
    (e : ∀ (M : A) (n : ℕ),
      (C.obj M).X n ≃+ LocallyConstant (Fin n → G) (E.functor.obj M).obj.V)
    (hm : ∀ (M N : A) (f : M ⟶ N) (n : ℕ) (x : (C.obj M).X n) (g : Fin n → G),
      e N n (((C.map f).f n) x) g = (E.functor.map f).hom.hom (e M n x g))
    (hd : ∀ (M : A) (n : ℕ) (x : (C.obj M).X n) (g : Fin (n + 1) → G),
      e M (n + 1) (((C.obj M).d n (n + 1)) x) g =
        (E.functor.obj M).obj.ρ (g 0) (e M n x (fun k ↦ g k.succ)) +
          ∑ k : Fin (n + 1),
            (-1 : ℤ) ^ (k.val + 1) • e M n x (Fin.contractNth k (· * ·) g))
    (M : A) : ∃ (N : A) (f : M ⟶ N), Mono f ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (C.obj N).ExactAt n
